question: Within the failed 32-angle by eight-conditional-radius carry code, is the remaining early distortion dominated by angular quantization, radial quantization, or under-utilization of the 256 states?

method.single_change: Add nonpersistent measurement at refresh steps 0 and 8; keep model, data, seed, optimizer, and representation identical to the rejected gate.
method.orthogonal_decomposition: centered target = projected radius times selected fixed direction + perpendicular residual; total squared codec error is angular error plus radial-level error.
method.state_usage: Report joint, angular, and conditional-radius entropies, active symbols, top-radius occupancy/energy, angle-conditioned radial RMS variation, and maximum-radius-to-RMS ratio.
method.training_decision_value: measurement only; loss is not an endpoint comparison

decision_policy.radial_dominated: If radial error is at least 70% of codec error, authorize a rate-matched 16-angle by 16-conditional-radius codec; preserve one uint8 per pair.
decision_policy.angular_dominated: If angular error is at least 70% of codec error, authorize a rate-matched 64-angle by four-conditional-radius codec.
decision_policy.mixed_well_occupied: If neither component dominates and joint entropy is high, stop product-code bit reallocations and design a one-byte non-product quantizer from the measured source geometry.
decision_policy.under_occupied: If joint entropy or active-state use is low, repair initialization or assignment before changing the representation family.

execution.expected_duration: under one minute on PRO6; foreground-polled
